rationale: Time ceilings are observed maxima x3 +250ms, rounded up to 100ms; memory is at least twice the sampled observed maximum, rounded to 64MiB. Reference checks exclude restore/build; a new process is used for each iteration. OS caches were not artificially purged; first-process is not claimed as cold-disk.
acceptanceBoundary: Budget only covers the fixed declaration fixture and CLI wall/observed sampling; IFX, assembly worker, cold NuGet/build and cancellation evidence remain separately reported.
